response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience, deep systems thinking, and exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks clear evidence of staff-level technical strategy, distributed systems ownership at scale, or direct experience with AI-native code production as a baseline — his work with AI tools is mentioned but not deeply contextualized, and his resume emphasizes breadth over the depth of ownership required for this role.
strengths: Proven full-stack expertise across languages and platforms including TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang
Active contributor to AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling at current role
Strong operational and open-source track record with Kubernetes, CI/CD, and system design
concerns: No explicit demonstration of leading technical strategy or architecture decisions at staff level
Limited evidence of high-throughput distributed systems with reliability SLAs in recent roles
AI/ML exposure mentioned but not shown as core competency or daily practice in agentic code environments
